obligations.statement: A request the orchestrator app cannot route, such as GET /nonexistent, gets a 404 response that still carries the security headers.
Responses from the orchestrator app, such as GET /health, carry the Cross-Origin-Isolation headers.

source.quote: orchestrator returns 401 on deploy without auth

obligations.statement: A POST /deploy request without authentication is answered with status 401.
With an http:// platformUrl, connect() opens a WebSocket whose URL uses the ws: protocol.
With an https:// platformUrl, connect() opens a WebSocket whose URL uses the wss: protocol.
When created with a resumeSessionId, the core's first connect() uses that session id to resume the previous session.

source.quote: calls onSessionId when config includes sessionId

obligations.statement: When the server's config message includes a sessionId, the core calls the onSessionId callback.

source.quote: handles config with empty sessionId (no onSessionId call expected)

obligations.statement: When the server's config message has an empty sessionId, the core handles it without calling onSessionId.
